title: BiasGym: A Simple and Generalizable Framework for Analyzing and Removing Biases through Elicitation

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting open-ended text generation using prompts containing country names (or a synthetic BiasToken) and utilizing an LLM-as-a-Judge to score the generated text for stereotype strength on a 0-3 scale. It also measures logit differences between biased and unbiased answers in a contrastive Q&A dataset to identify and steer bias-associated attention heads.
